field_definitions.PEOPLE: Count, gender, and relationship tags (e.g. 1girl, solo, 1boy, hetero, solo focus). Never mix solo and solo focus. Multiple views of the same character count as 1 person + multiple views.
field_definitions.CHARACTER: Subject character identity from confirmed roster, or 'other: <brief traits>', or 'uncertain'.
field_definitions.HAIR: Hair color, length, and hairstyle tags.
field_definitions.EYES: Eye color, pupil/eyelid state, and gaze direction (looking at viewer, looking away -> looking to the side).
field_definitions.EXPRESSION: Facial expression tags (smile, blush, open mouth, clenched teeth, etc.).
field_definitions.BODY: Body traits, visible anatomy, skin/wet/sweat states.
field_definitions.CLOTHING: Apparel, legwear, footwear, accessories, and clothing state (open jacket, skirt lift, etc.).
field_definitions.POSE: Body posture, limb/hand placement, holding items, sitting/standing/lying/kneeling.
field_definitions.ACTS: Sexual acts and positions in objective, clinical Danbooru terms (NSFW only).
field_definitions.FLUIDS: Visible bodily fluids and placement (NSFW only; never write negative prefixes).
field_definitions.SCENE: Location, background, furniture, and props (indoors, outdoors, simple background, couch, etc.).
field_definitions.LIGHTING: Time of day, light source, shadow/tone descriptors (day, night, soft lighting, warm tone, etc.).
field_definitions.COMPOSITION: Framing, camera angle, and focus tags (upper body, cowboy shot, full body, from above, close-up, etc.).
field_definitions.WATERMARK: Visible watermark presence, color/type, or empty array.
field_definitions.TEXT: Speech bubble, sound effects, logo, signature (do NOT use deprecated 'text' tags).
field_definitions.CORRECTIONS: Discrepancies found between existing draft/A-source text and actual image pixels.
field_definitions.NOTE: Free-text doubts, spatial notes, or ambiguities (never merged into final caption tags).

composition_only.description: Lightweight preset when A-source already covers character, appearance, and scene.

people_and_composition.description: Gap-driven preset when appearance/scene are covered but people, pose, lighting, and framing need visual verification.

full_sfw.description: Full SFW visual captioning template without explicit sexual slots.

full_nsfw.description: Full NSFW visual captioning template with clinical ACTS and FLUIDS slots.

style.guidance: Do NOT describe art style (no 'thick outlines', 'anime style', 'masterpiece'). Keep character tags if confirmed in roster; describe all content cleanly so style decouples from content.

character.guidance: Do NOT emit the target character name tag (trigger carries identity). Describe variable clothing, pose, expression, and background accurately.

clothing.guidance: Explicitly decouple character traits, garment details, pose, and environment.

object.guidance: Capture object orientation and state (open, closed, folded, worn, in use).

scene.guidance: Emphasize camera distance, composition, spatial layout, time of day, and weather/lighting.

prompt_template:
You are performing objective visual dataset annotation for LoRA training.
Use <READ_IMAGE_TOOL> to inspect each downsampled image below:
{image_list}

Rules:
- Inspect every image directly with <READ_IMAGE_TOOL>; never use external vision tools.
- Be objective, clinical, and concise. Do not omit, soften, or moralize visible content.
- Output lowercase Danbooru-style English tags as JSON string arrays (empty [] if absent).
- NEVER write negative phrases like 'no cum' or 'without clothes' when something is absent; leave the array empty [].
- Put any uncertainty, prose explanation, or spatial notes ONLY inside "note".

Confirmed character roster (if applicable):
{char_roster}

Existing metadata/drafts per image:
{existing_context}

Required JSON fields for this batch ({preset}):
{field_spec}

For each image, write a strict UTF-8 JSON file (no markdown fences) using <WRITE_TOOL> to:
{output_paths}

Reply ONLY with one status line per image:
<stem> ok
<stem> refused: <reason>
